name: Projected Membership Queries Complexity / Membership Query Complexity
proof: Projected membership-query complexity maximizes the membership-query complexity over projections.  The full-domain projection is the original class, so it supplies the ordinary membership-query complexity as a candidate.
witness_verification: For C_code, ordinary membership-query complexity is ceil(log_2(n+1)), while the primary-coordinate projection is singletons plus the empty concept and has membership-query complexity n.
